{"id":1989782114,"question_id":9,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"2 months, 3 weeks","timestamp":1777331076,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"0 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1989782114/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Palindrome Number","memory":"8.5 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    using ll = long long;\n    bool isPalindrome(int x) {\n        ll rev = 0;\n        int y = x;\n\n        while(x > 0)\n        {\n            int digit = x % 10;\n            rev = rev * 10 + digit;\n            x /= 10;\n        }\n        return y == rev;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"palindrome-number","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1953}
